title: Installing Access Symbols at Tables Reserved for Disabled and Care-givers
what_it_is: Installing Access Symbols at Tables Reserved for Disabled and Care-givers

sections.label: Accessible tables in eating establishments
sections.summary: The Code on Accessibility requires eating establishments to set aside at least one in 10 tables for persons with disabilities, marked with an access symbol.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Code on Accessibility already requires eating establishments like hawker centres, food courts, fast food outlets and restaurants to set aside at least one in every 10 tables for use by persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: A symbol of access is affixed to these tables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The intention is clearly to give priority to persons with disabilities and their companions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Ultimately, what we want is an inclusive and gracious society and we will certainly take the Member's feedback and send it, pass it on to the Building and Construction Authority (BCA).
